title: (Why) Is My Prompt Getting Worse? Rethinking Regression Testing for Evolving LLM APIs

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model performance regressions across data slices to determine if toxicity classification accuracy disproportionately degrades on texts where the toxicity is triggered by politics or ideology after LLM API updates.

Evaluating model performance regressions across data slices based on the target of the toxicity (e.g., directed at people, code, or companies) to identify disproportionate performance impacts due to model updates.
